spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-001: Implement PostgreSQL Schema and Vector Extensions
spreadsheet.description: Configure the database schema including 'meetings' and 'action_items' tables. Enable pgvector extension for the 'vector_embedding' field (1536 dimensions). Include migration scripts for AuditLog table to track state changes.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-002: Integrate Whisper API for Audio Transcription
spreadsheet.description: Develop a service worker to ingest MP3/WAV files, interface with the OpenAI Whisper API, and parse the output into the required JSON format containing timestamps, speaker IDs, and raw text.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-003: Setup OIDC Middleware and RBAC Guard
spreadsheet.description: Implement authentication middleware for Azure AD/Okta via OIDC. Enforce RBAC constraints: Admin (CRUD), Manager (Project-level write), Employee (Action-item update) based on JWT claims.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-004: Develop Calendar Sync Cron Service
spreadsheet.description: Create a background worker to periodically poll linked calendar APIs (Microsoft Graph/Google), create 'meeting' records, and trigger automated processing jobs for upcoming events.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-005: Qdrant Vector Collection and Semantic Search API
spreadsheet.description: Initialize Qdrant collection for meeting embeddings. Implement an endpoint to transform user natural language queries into vectors and retrieve ranked relevant meeting excerpts.
Build the Executive view in React/Next.js. Include data visualization for Risk/KPI trends and a search bar component that consumes the Semantic Search API.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-007: PM Meeting/Action Item Management UI
spreadsheet.description: Develop the PM interface for linking meetings to external tools (Jira/DevOps). Implement the UI to review AI-generated MoMs and manually override action item assignments.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-008: Implement Action Item Status Workflow
spreadsheet.description: Create API endpoints for updating 'action_items' statuses. Ensure transitions validate against the allowed state machine (Open -> In Progress -> Completed/Blocked).

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-009: Fix: Ensure AES-256 Encryption at Rest
spreadsheet.description: Configure cloud-provider managed encryption (KMS) for the database volume and S3 buckets storing raw audio to meet compliance mandates.
